written.myAnswer: System software manages and supports the operation of a computer system. Examples include an operating system and a device driver.
An operating system manages hardware resources, provides a user interface, and runs applications. It allocates resources such as CPU time and memory so applications can run effectively.

Utility software helps maintain and manage a computer system. It is important for efficient, secure, and reliable operation. Examples include Disk Cleanup, antivirus software, backup software, and file compression tools.

Device drivers enable communication between the operating system and hardware devices. They translate general instructions into instructions a particular device can understand; for example, a printer driver helps the computer communicate with a printer.

System software manages and supports the computer and provides an environment for applications to run; examples include an operating system and device drivers. Application software helps users perform specific tasks, such as creating documents; Microsoft Word is an example.

System software manages hardware and software resources and provides an environment in which applications can run. The operating system manages resources and provides a user interface, utility software helps maintain system efficiency and security, and device drivers enable communication between the operating system and hardware.

An operating system manages the computer's resources, provides a user interface, and runs applications; Windows is an example. Utility software maintains or manages the system, such as Disk Cleanup or antivirus software. Device drivers enable communication between the operating system and hardware, such as a printer driver.

System software manages and supports the computer and provides an environment for applications; examples include operating systems, utilities, and device drivers. Application software performs specific tasks for users, such as creating documents or presentations; Microsoft Word is an example.

Use Disk Cleanup to scan for and remove unnecessary files. Run antivirus software to scan files and incoming data and enable real-time protection. Schedule backup software to copy files to an external drive, cloud storage, or a network location. Use file compression tools to reduce file sizes for storage or transfer.

Install the appropriate driver when a hardware device needs one to communicate with the operating system. Update it to maintain compatibility and performance. If the device malfunctions, check that the driver is installed, current, and compatible with both the device and the operating system.
